title: Secret Sync Preflight
user: A DevOps developer moving configuration through IaC, a secret manager, CI, and hosting providers who needs to detect missing, excess, stale, or provider-limited secrets before deployment.
smallest_useful_product: CLI reads a key-only desired manifest and provider exports, highlights missing, extra, renamed keys, detects destination limits and dangerous delete plans, and emits CI annotations without reading values.
success_measure: In a seeded multi-environment fixture, it catches all missing, extra, renamed, and over-limit key states without printing a secret value; a team blocks one unsafe deployment via CI.
constraints: Metadata-only by default; never log values; provider tokens must be least-privilege/read-only; treat key names as potentially sensitive and support local reports.
